map.经验表和选择表怎么选？: How to choose between experience and select tables?
map.经验表反映已承保人群实际死亡率（通常低于国民表），选择表额外体现投保后前几年更健: Experience tables reflect actual mortality of the insured (usually below the national table); select tables additionally capture the healthier selection effect in early policy years. Pricing with select tables fits real risk better.
